# Dark theme, unpinned

The deck-wide flip is keyed on `data-theme$="-dark"`, so this slide's mark takes the
inverse treatment without any slide class saying so.

---

<!-- _class: light -->

# Pinned light inside a dark deck

A slide that pins its own ground back to light must take the mark back with it.

---

<!-- _class: color-light -->

# The deck-wide light pin, as a slide class

`color-light` resets the same pair, for the same reason.
